_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ LinesOfAction agorɔ mu.
Wo pieces ne '{side}', ɔpono pieces ne '{other}'.
Nkrɔfoɔ format: `[b1b3]` (firi-coord kɔ-coord). Nkrɔfoɔ a ɛfata ɛkɔ ho kɔ ho, akyirikyiri, anaa ɔkɔtɔ kɔkɔmɛ ɛsɛ ɛyɛ squares dodoɔ a ɛyɛ pieces dodoɔ (kɔla biara) wɔ saa line no mu. Wo betumi akɔtɔ wo pieces ankasa, nanso ɔpono pieces nni; ɛba wo ɔpono so a, wo kyere no.  Wo di nkunim wɔ bere a wo pieces nyinaa ɛne wo pieces foforɔ bɛn wɔ 8-neighbour connected.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ɛsɛ sɛ ne mfoni no yɛ e2e4 (fi,kɔ coordinates).
invalid_move.identical: Baabi a efi ne baabi a ɛkɔ yɛ pɛ.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ tee anaa ɛkwan a wɔfa so.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtwe wɔn ho kɔ akyiri te sɛ nea wɔde akosi ɔfã biara so pɛpɛɛpɛ.
invalid_move.enemy_blocks: Ɔtamfo bi a ɔwɔ kwan no mu.
invalid_move.destination_own: Baabi a wɔrekɔ no, wɔn ankasa de wɔn nsa ka.

game_action.captured_suffix: Ɔdan {player_id} tu kɔ {from} -> {to} de kɔto nneɛma a ɛyɛ dɔm.
